info.title: EximPe Payment Gateway API — v3 Payment Links
info.description: Create, list, retrieve and deactivate payment links on the v3 API. v1 and v2 use the same paths; this spec carries the v3 contract.

post.description: Create a payment link: a URL you send to a buyer to collect one INR payment. It stays open until it is paid, expires, or is deactivated.

UPI link sent to the buyer.summary: UPI link sent to the buyer
UPI link sent to the buyer.description: Restricts the link to UPI, sets an expiry, and sends the link to the buyer by SMS and email.

Physical goods, default expiry.description: No expiry_date, so the link expires one year from today. Physical goods need an hs_code.

400.description: The request was refused. error.code is ERR_ORDER_002; details says what failed.

Invalid fields.description: Field errors are keyed by field and nested the way the request is.

invoice.number: Invoice number must contain only alphanumeric characters.

details.expiry_date: Expiry date cannot be beyond 1 year from now.

Payment method not supported.description: preferred_payment_method names a method this account's payment links cannot collect.

details.preferred_payment_method: Credit card is not supported for payment links on this account

get.description: Return a paginated list of your payment links, newest first.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Stop when `next` is null: a page past the last one is refused with a 500.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Links per page. Values above 1000 are capped at 1000.

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: Sort order. Prefix with `-` for descending.

value.message: Domestic payment link requests retrieved successfully

value.detail: You do not have permission to perform this action.

get.description: Fetch one payment link by its link_id: its status, the payments made through it, its expiry, buyer, product, invoice and settlement.

parameters.name: link_id
parameters.description: The link's `link_id`, as returned by Create Payment Link (`PR` followed by 10 digits). The `payment_id` Create Payment Link returns is the same value.

Paid on the second try.description: The buyer's first try failed and the second went through. Each try is a payment with its own payment_id; paid_payment_id names the one that paid the link.

clientAuth.name: X-Client-ID
clientAuth.description: **Client Application ID** - Your unique application identifier used to authenticate API requests. You can find your Client ID in the Developer Settings section of the merchant dashboard.

clientSecretAuth.name: X-Client-Secret
clientSecretAuth.description: **Client Secret Key** - Your secret key used alongside the Client ID for secure authentication. Keep this confidential and never expose it in client-side code. Available in the Developer Settings section of the merchant dashboard.

merchantAuth.name: X-Merchant-ID
merchantAuth.description: **Merchant Identifier** - The unique ID for the merchant account. This is required for PSP (Payment Service Provider) merchants who manage multiple merchant accounts. You can find merchant IDs in the Merchant Management section of the dashboard.

apiVersionHeader.name: X-API-Version
apiVersionHeader.description: **API Version** - Specifies which version of the API to use (e.g., '1.X.X', '2.X.X', or '3.X.X'). This header allows you to control which API version your integration uses. Default version information is available in the Developer Settings.

amount.description: Amount to collect, in rupees, as a decimal string (e.g. "1500.00"). Up to two decimal places; greater than 0 and at most 10,000,000.00. Payment links are always INR, so there is no currency field.

reference_id.description: Your reference for this payment. Letters, numbers and hyphens. Unique across all your orders, including one whose link failed to create.

expiry_date.description: When the link stops accepting payment (ISO 8601). A value without an offset is read as UTC. Must be in the future and at most one year (365 days) away. Omit it, or send null, and the link expires 365 days from today.

preferred_payment_method.description: The payment method the buyer should pay with. Case-insensitive. Omit it to let the buyer choose. Which methods a payment link can collect depends on your account; one it cannot is refused with a 400.

business_model.description: Whether the buyer is a business (B2B) or a consumer (B2C). Optional — derived from the merchant's KYC when omitted.

purpose_code.description: FEMA/FETERS purpose code this payment settles under (e.g. S0802). Optional — derived from the merchant's allowed purpose codes when omitted and exactly one is allowed.

phone.description: Buyer's phone number with country code (e.g. +919876543210). A number without the + and country code is refused.

send_sms.description: Send the payment link to the buyer's phone by SMS once it is created.

send_email.description: Send the payment link to the buyer's email once it is created.

hs_code.description: 8-digit Harmonized System code. Required for physical_goods and checked against the HS code list, but not stored on the link.

hs_code_description.description: Description of the HS code. Accepted, but not stored on the link.

number.description: Invoice number. Letters and numbers only — no hyphens, slashes or spaces. Unique across your orders that have not failed.

success.description: Indicates if the request was successful

payment_id.description: The same value as link_id, kept for compatibility. Read link_id.

link_id.description: The link's ID (PR followed by 10 digits). Retrieve and Deactivate take it, and every payment made through the link carries it in its payment webhooks, next to that payment's own payment_id.

payment_link.description: The URL to send to the buyer. Treat it as opaque.

amount.description: The amount, as a decimal string. A whole amount comes back without decimals ("1500"); any other with two ("1500.50").

success.description: Indicates if the request was successful

count.description: Total number of links across all pages

next.description: Full URL of the next page, or null on the last page

previous.description: Full URL of the previous page, or null on the first page

payment_id.description: The same value as link_id, kept for compatibility

link_id.description: The link's ID. Retrieve and Deactivate take it.

payment_link.description: The URL sent to the buyer. Null when the link could not be created.

merchant.description: The merchant the link belongs to. For a PSP: its own account or one of its sub-merchants.

name.description: Merchant's trade name, or legal name when it has none

reference_id.description: Your reference_id from Create Payment Link

order_id.description: The order behind the link (OD followed by 10 digits)

invoice_number.description: The invoice number sent on create

amount.description: Amount to collect, as a decimal string without trailing zeros ("1500", "2499.5")

total_amount.description: The amount including GST where GST applies; otherwise equal to amount

created_at.description: When the link was created. UTC, ISO 8601 with microseconds (e.g. `2026-09-14T09:30:15.123456Z`).

comment.description: Why the link failed or closed, when there is a reason to give; otherwise null

mop_type.description: The method the buyer paid with, in lowercase (e.g. upi, credit_card, net_banking). Can be null even after the link is paid.

status.description: Where the link stands. `active`: open for payment. `paid`: paid; this outranks an expiry that has since passed. `expired`: past its expiry_date, or deactivated. `failed`: could not be created, or closed without being paid.

success.description: Indicates if the request was successful

v3_PaymentLinkDetails.description: The link, and the payments made through it. The link's amount is not included: keep the one from the create response, or read it from List Payment Links.

payment_id.description: The same value as link_id, kept for compatibility

reference_id.description: Your reference_id from Create Payment Link

payment_link.description: The URL sent to the buyer. Null when the link could not be created.

expiry_date.description: When the link stops accepting payment; the moment of deactivation for a deactivated link. UTC, ISO 8601 with microseconds (e.g. `2026-09-14T09:30:15.123456Z`).

mop_type.description: The method the buyer paid with, in uppercase (e.g. UPI, CREDIT_CARD, NET_BANKING). Can be null even after the link is paid.

pan_number.description: Buyer's PAN, when one has been collected

dob.description: Buyer's date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD), when one has been collected

hs_code.description: HS code, when one is stored on the order

hs_code_description.description: HS code description, when one is stored on the order

type_of_goods.description: Type of goods: physical_goods, digital_goods or service

date.description: Invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD), when one is recorded

file.description: Time-limited download URL for the invoice file, when one has been uploaded

air_waybills.description: Air waybills recorded against the link's order; usually empty

file.description: Time-limited download URL for the air waybill file

status.description: Where the link stands. `active`: open for payment. `paid`: paid; this outranks an expiry that has since passed. `expired`: past its expiry_date, or deactivated. `failed`: could not be created, or closed without being paid.

status_message.description: Why the link failed or closed, when there is a reason to give; otherwise null

created_at.description: When the link was created. UTC, ISO 8601 with microseconds (e.g. `2026-09-14T09:30:15.123456Z`).

paid_payment_id.description: The payment_id of the payment that paid the link, or null until it is paid. Refund and reconcile by this ID, not by link_id. On some accounts a link and its payment share one ID, and this equals link_id.

payments.description: The payments made through the link, newest first; at most the 50 newest. A buyer may try more than once: where each try is a payment of its own, every try is listed, and this is empty until the buyer first tries to pay. On some accounts a link and its payment share one ID: this then holds one entry whose payment_id is link_id, from the moment the link is created.

v3_PaymentLinkPayment.description: A payment made through the link

payment_id.description: The payment's ID (PR followed by 10 digits). Refund and reconcile by it. Its payment webhooks carry it with the link's link_id.

status.description: Where the payment stands. `PENDING`: under way. `CAPTURED`: it went through. `FAILED`, or rarely `INVALID`: it did not.

mop_type.description: The method the payment was made with, in uppercase (e.g. UPI, CREDIT_CARD, NET_BANKING), or null when none is recorded.

amount.description: The payment's amount, as a decimal string with two decimals ("1500.00"). Parse it as a decimal, never as a float.

created_at.description: When the payment was made. UTC, ISO 8601 with microseconds (e.g. `2026-09-14T09:30:15.123456Z`).

payment_completed_at.description: When the payment completed, in the same format; null until it has, and usually null for a payment that failed.

v3_PaymentLinkSettlement.description: Settlement state recorded against the link. When paid_payment_id differs from link_id, the money moved on that payment rather than on the link, and this does not follow it: reconcile by paid_payment_id.

message.description: Detail on the settlement status, when there is any

settlement_details.description: Null until the payment is part of a settlement

v3_PaymentLinkSettlementDetails.description: Amounts are decimal strings with two decimals, or null.

settlement_id.description: Settlement ID (ST…). Pass it to Get Settlement.

settlement_completed_at.description: When the settlement completed. UTC, ISO 8601 with microseconds (e.g. `2026-09-14T09:30:15.123456Z`).

merchant_transaction_id.description: The payment network's reference for the transaction

card_type.description: Card type, for a card payment

offer_service_tax.description: Tax on the offer service fee

additional_tdr_tax.description: Tax on the additional TDR fee

success.description: Indicates if the request was successful

code.description: Error code (e.g., ERR_ORDER_002). The list endpoint's own failure sends a number (40350).

details.description: What failed. Usually an object keyed by the offending field and nested the way the request is (e.g. buyer.address.postal_code), with one message per field. A purpose_code refusal sends a single string instead.

success.description: Indicates if the request was successful. Always false for error responses.

v3_PermissionDeniedResponse.description: Returned when payment links are not enabled on the account. It does not use the standard error envelope.
